name: Offline Smart Translate
description: Translate text on this device with automatic language detection and on-demand offline language models. Requires Link speech-to-text and Persian text-to-speech plugins for voice input and read-aloud.

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.attribution: Google ML Kit Translation and Language Identification APIs

release_notes: Adds automatic installation of Link speech-to-text and Persian text-to-speech dependencies. Translation models remain downloaded on demand and are not bundled in the plugin.
